title: Roasted pepper chickpea salad
summary: Roasted pepper chickpea salad is a mediterranean dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook canned chickpeas in water for Roasted pepper chickpea salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss red peppers with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Roasted pepper chickpea salad straight away. Taste Roasted pepper chickpea salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
